definitions.explanation: A child who has become separated from their parents or guardians.

definitions.gloss: lost person, someone who is lost
definitions.explanation: By extension, anyone who has lost their way (often used playfully for adults).

examples.japanese: {迷子|まいご}になった{子供|こども}を{保護|ほご}した。
「{迷子|まいご}のお{知|し}らせです」と{店内|てんない}アナウンスが{流|なが}れた。
examples.english: A store announcement played: 'We have a lost child announcement.'

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}で{迷子|まいご}になってしまった。
examples.english: I got lost at the station.
examples.notes: Can be used for adults, often playfully

notes:
While literally referring to children, often used humorously for adults who are lost.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{迷子|まいご}になる (to get lost)
・{迷子|まいご}センター (lost child center)
・{迷子|まいご}のお{知|し}らせ (lost child announcement)
・{迷子|まいご}{札|ふだ} (lost child tag - worn by children at events)

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
・{道|みち}に{迷|まよ}う (to lose one's way)
・はぐれる (to get separated from a group)

NOTE:
The kanji {迷|まい} means "to be lost/confused" and {子|ご} means "child."
